articles.title: The next trillion-dollar currency may not be a stablecoin — it might not even have a name yet
articles.snippet: AI agents are coming. They will need to pay each other. Crypto executives agree on the problem but disagree sharply on the solution, and one thinks the answer has not been invented yet.

articles.title: Japanese regulator requests tax filing exemption for trust-type stablecoins in 2027 reform
articles.snippet: Japan’s FSA requested to exempt trust-type stablecoins from mandatory tax filings starting in fiscal year 2027, arguing that it would improve their use as transaction tools.

articles.title: Stablecoins not credible for payments at scale, BIS chief says
articles.snippet: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos said stablecoins lack credibility for payments at scale, while a new FSI study highlights sharp differences in issuer rules.

articles.title: Chelsea FC gets a stablecoin sponsor after UK FCA warning to clubs
articles.snippet: According to Circle, the USDC stablecoin name will appear on the front of club jerseys for Chelsea’s upcoming football season.

articles.title: Bullish provides USD.AI $100M stablecoin facility for GPU-backed lending
articles.snippet: The institutional crypto exchange is providing $100 million in stablecoin liquidity to support loans backed by AI computing infrastructure.
